title: Virtual Compute: assisted review — us location
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute assisted review — Multiply the selected primary rate by the contracted location-specific rate multiplier value for the holding location.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for assisted review — us location?**

Multiply the selected primary rate by the contracted location-specific rate multiplier value for the holding location.

## US location values

Assisted primary review multipliers are 1 for US East and 1.04 for US West.
